description: Full-text search the current Code of Federal Regulations (eCFR, all 50 titles) for a phrase or keywords. Returns matching sections with their citation (e.g. '40 CFR 98.411'), hierarchy heading, a text snippet, effective date, and the official eCFR URL, plus the total match count. Use reg_cfr_section to read a full section's text.

query.description: Phrase or keywords to find in the CFR, e.g. 'greenhouse gas reporting'.

name: reg_cfr_search
